lesson.title: Newtonian Motion
lesson.summary: A brief overview of Newton's three laws of motion with simple examples.
lesson.xhtml:
Newtonian Motion

Motion begins with an introduction to forces.

  1. First law explains inertia.
  2. Second law relates force, mass, and acceleration.
  3. Third law covers equal and opposite reactions.

Conclusion highlights how the laws combine to describe everyday motion.
